records.claim_text: The Hundred Years' War includes the Civil War.
records.gold_evidence: The Hundred Years ' War was a series of conflicts waged from 1337 to 1453 by the House of Plantagenet , rulers of the Kingdom of England , against the House of Valois , rulers of the Kingdom of France , over the succession of the French throne . The American Civil War was fought in the United States from 1861 to 1865 .
